summary:
Viktor breathes sharply as he stares at the spread-out notes and accepts the truth: there’s nothing left to glean. He could keep the notes across his desk as company or tuck them away somewhere safe, but there’s no new discovery to be made between the lines. Jayce’s input, his phantom partner, is…at its end.
Viktor massages the bridge of his nose to stop a brewing headache and the sting behind his eyes.
How strange to grieve a long dead man.
____
Jayce finally arrives to Ekko and Heimerdinger's alternate stream. Except, in this world, Jayce is dead and he finds Viktor has continued his research in solitude.
